import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    mn = None
    mx = None
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        x = int(data[i])
        if i == 1:
            mn = mx = x
        else:
            if x < mn:
                mn = x
            if x > mx:
                mx = x
    result = mn + (mx - mn) // 2
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
